name: Calendar Desk
description: Keeps your calendar and the notes you leave on meetings, and sends a short prep note before a meeting starts. Reminders and dated to-dos live on your Flock to-do list.
_comment: Runs OUT OF PROCESS like Slack Desk, on @flock/app-sdk (platform-supplied into node_modules). Two clocks: the platform's hourly app-relay tick does the heavy, lease-taking work (scrape); the app's own 1-minute loop evaluates the meeting-prep window from the local store. Reminders are Flock TODOs, not this app's.

agent.label: Agent that prepares you for meetings

intents.name: meeting_prep
intents.description: A meeting starts within the prep window. Write a short prep note.

operations.name: refresh_calendar
operations.description: Re-read Google Calendar now: {force?: true to ignore the 2-hour freshness window}. Daily cap still applies.

operations.name: list_upcoming
operations.description: Calendar events in the next {days:14} days.

operations.name: set_event_note
operations.description: Attach what you should do before a meeting: {match:{date:'YYYY-MM-DD', titleContains:'…'}, note}. Returns AMBIGUOUS with candidates when several match.

agentInterface.instructions: 'What's on my calendar' or 'what's coming up' is list_upcoming — answer from it, never by opening the calendar. A note about what to do before a meeting is set_event_note. refresh_calendar re-reads Google Calendar when the user says it looks out of date. Reminders and to-dos are not handled here; they belong on the user's Flock to-do list. When you receive meeting_prep: write a prep note within the budget given (who is attending and what memory says about them, the user's note verbatim, open threads with those people from the last 14 days); if memory has nothing, say so in one line rather than nothing; end with the waiting-on-user block.

routines.name: Prepare me before meetings
routines.description: Shortly before a meeting, your assistant sends a short prep note: who is coming, what you said you wanted to raise, and what memory knows about them.
routines._cronComment: The owner-visible cadence. The app's own loop evaluates the window every minute; this routine's enabled flag and config are what the loop reads.
